title: Style Spec v2 — doctor-approved (2026-10-22)
summary: Style Spec v1 plus: Advice and Follow-up on their own lines, each label once per problem, a Diagnosis only if the clinician said it, every addressed issue in the plan, an Allergies line, and a side check.

rules.text: Subjective is grouped under topic headings; the first topic is Presenting Complaint.
Bullets are short clinical clauses (at most 24 words), never paragraphs.
No lifestyle, diet, habits, smoking, alcohol, social or family topics in Subjective (they belong in Past Medical History).
Every fact and every denial appears once; no repeated bullets.
Bullets start with the finding, not with "The patient".
At most about six bullets (plus the Medications line).
At most one Medications line, with no repeated drug.
No addresses or housing details.
No lines that only say something was not mentioned.
Vital signs carry numbers; statements without numbers are history, not vitals.
A result is stated once; the results of one panel are grouped on one line.
No patient-reported statements in Objective.
Numbered problems, one per distinct issue.
Plain problem titles: no rule-out lists, suspected causes, "vs" or question marks.
Each investigation, treatment, advice item or follow-up appears once, under its problem.
Assessment lines hold the clinician's conclusion or the status the transcript shows (stable, improved, worse, new), never a retelling of the history.
Refills sit under the condition the drug treats, not in a separate refills problem.
No separate Follow-up problem.
A Diagnosis line is only a diagnosis the clinician said, never just the symptom title.
No wording such as unspecified / not mentioned / not stated.
Each plan label (Investigations planned, Treatment planned, Referrals, Advice, Follow-up) appears at most once per problem; several items are joined with semicolons.
Advice, safety-netting and return precautions are on their own Advice line, not inside Treatment planned.
Follow-up timing (and the tests it needs) is on its own Follow-up line, not inside Treatment planned, and is never a separate problem.
Every issue the clinician addressed has its own problem, in the order discussed; an issue is added only with a quote from the transcript, and never from an earlier visit.
Allergies and their reactions are on their own Allergies line when stated.
A left/right side that the recording does not name is flagged for the doctor to check, never changed silently.

No hallucination: a grounding agent checks every line against the transcript; a line the recording does not support is removed, a doubtful one is flagged for the doctor ("Please check against the recording").

(Built, off by default after the 2026-10-22 paired A/B.) A condition (and a problem title that names a disease) is only in the note if the recording says it, or says the drug that proves it. A result alone ("sugars 6.1") never makes a diagnosis; the title then names the measurement ("Blood sugar").
Every investigation, treatment and referral sits under the problem it is for; an item is moved only when the transcript shows where it belongs (quoted), and its wording never changes.

Past Medical History describes the patient only: a partner's age, surgery or therapy, or an ex-wife, is not the patient's history (family history of the patient and the patient's own social line stay).
